description: This file defines the OCIContainer class, which implements a plugin handling JSONRPC communication for container management, including methods for container lifecycle operations and event handling within the WPEFramework plugin architecture.

classes.name: OCIContainer
classes.description: A plugin class for managing containers via JSONRPC, inheriting from PluginHost::IPlugin and PluginHost::JSONRPC, providing container lifecycle methods, event handlers, and plugin interface implementations.

methods.name: listContainers
methods.description: Lists containers based on provided parameters and fills the response object.

methods.name: getContainerState
methods.description: Retrieves the state of a specified container.

methods.name: getContainerInfo
methods.description: Fetches detailed information about a specific container.

methods.name: startContainerFromDobbySpec
methods.description: Starts a container using a Dobby specification.

methods.name: executeCommand
methods.description: Executes a command inside a container.

methods.name: onContainerStarted
methods.description: Event handler called when a container starts.

methods.name: onContainerStopped
methods.description: Event handler called when a container stops.

methods.name: onVerityFailed
methods.description: Event handler called when container verification fails.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the shell service.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up the plugin before shutdown.

methods.name: getApiVersionNumber
methods.description: Returns the API version number, fixed at 1.
